Formwork reported only where measurement basis is standard and unambiguous: beam sides+soffit (0.75 m2/m) and slab soffits; column four faces. No footing formwork assumed (often cast in excavations) — exclude until specified. Stair flight concrete is explicitly pending and not included. No rebar weights provided. All dimensions in metres; datum wall centrelines. Preliminary AI takeoff — review by a quantity surveyor is required.
